translation: Bitter in flavor, non-toxic. It returns to the bones (歸骨) and is the xie of vegetables (菜芝). It removes chills and fever, removes water qi (去水氣), warms the center (溫中), disperses bindings (散結), benefits sick people (利病患), and is smeared on all sores with wind-cold-water-swelling (諸瘡中風寒水腫).
